learnings.subject: Emergency Dematter Cream
learnings.learning: Dematter paid ROAS fell to RED (1.43 vs 2.07 breakeven) in the same window its 'detangler for dogs' organic rank slid 8->13 - possible pattern: rising paid spend masking organic decline; check organic rank before scaling Dematter paid.
evidence: ROAS 1.43 on $318.18 spend (Supermetrics Query B, 2026-07-08)
Organic rank 'detangler for dogs' 8->13 (H10 Daily Keyword Tracker, 2026-07-08)

2026-07-10: 'detangler for dogs' rank slid further to 7 (from a baseline of 5), and 'dog detangler' dropped 9 spots (7->16) - organic instability continues, but paid ROAS remains unverifiable (Supermetrics down 2nd straight day) so this cannot be confirmed or contradicted today

2026-07-11: 'detangler for dogs' rank collapsed 7->23 (-16 spots), the largest single-day drop yet in this pattern (H10 Daily Keyword Tracker, report date 2026-07-10); other Dematter keywords ('dog detangler', 'dematting comb for dogs', 'dematting spray for dogs') all improved the same day, so this is isolated to one keyword, not a whole-listing decline. Paid ROAS impact still unverifiable - Supermetrics 3rd consecutive day of total outage

2026-07-12: 'detangler for dogs' reversed sharply, 23->8 (+15 spots), the largest single-day recovery yet (H10 Daily Keyword Tracker, report date 2026-07-11) - the keyword is now more volatile in both directions than any other Dematter keyword. Paid ROAS impact still unverifiable - Supermetrics 4th consecutive day of total outage. This does not confirm the original 'decline' direction, but does reinforce that this specific keyword is unusually unstable; driver remains unidentified without paid-spend visibility.

2026-07-13: 'detangler for dogs' and 'dog detangler' are absent entirely from today's Daily Keyword Tracker report (only 'dematting tool for dogs' and 'dematting comb for dogs' listed for this SKU) - report display gap, not a confirmed rank change either direction. Paid ROAS impact still unverifiable - Supermetrics 5th consecutive day of total outage.

2026-07-14: both keywords reappear in today's report. 'detangler for dogs' r8 (no change shown), 'dog detangler' r7 (no change shown) - ranks stable, volatility appears to have settled. Supermetrics back online: Dematter ROAS 1.33 on $325.03 7d spend - still RED vs 2.07 breakeven. Pattern holds: rank stabilized but ROAS not recovered.

2026-07-21: 'dematting tool for dogs' r9 (-2), 'dematting comb for dogs' r22 (+5 - not in top 50 previously, improvement). Both Dematter and Detangler keywords stable vs prior day. Pattern update: original 'detangler for dogs' volatility resolved; current tracking keywords now 'dematting tool for dogs' and 'dematting comb for dogs'.
2026-07-23: 'dematting tool for dogs' r9 (no change) per H10 Jul 22 report. 7d ROAS 0.69 on $1,329.22 spend - RED band persists. Pattern unchanged.
2026-07-26: 'dematting tool for dogs' r7 (-2), 'dematting comb for dogs' r22 (+5). 7d ROAS 0.69 (RED band). TACOS 145.3% vs 15% target.

2026-07-27: 'dematting tool for dogs' r7 (stable). 14d ROAS 1.29 on $214.14 spend - RED vs 2.07 breakeven. 14d total organic+paid sales $1,075.90 (Supermetrics Query D FRESH). TACOS 19.9% on 14d window. Per DOCTRINE: organic carrying performance; hold bids while organic rank stable at r7.
learnings.action_implication: Monitor paid ROAS vs organic rank weekly. Dematter 14d ad ROAS 1.29 RED (breakeven 2.07). TACOS 19.9% on 14d window - organic carrying performance. Hold bids while rank r7 stable; do not scale paid until ad ROAS crosses yellow band 1.66.

learnings.subject: CTR > 2% with zero purchases = post-click failure, not creative
learnings.learning: When a Meta ad shows CTR > 2% (clicks are happening) but zero purchases result, the failure is post-click (landing page, checkout, product page) not creative. Applying CPM reduction Levers 1-3 to a post-click failure wastes spend. Lever 4 (CTR push) is also skipped when CTR > 3% since engagement is not the bottleneck. Diagnose: pull landing page bounce rate and checkout abandonment before changing creative or targeting.
evidence: 2026-07-16: Established as diagnostic framework for Blaze CPM Reduction Playbook v2.0.

2026-07-27: Shampoo 50OFF (ad 120217XXXX) CTR 3.41%, $81.26 14d spend, $0 confirmed purchases (threshold breach). Post-click diagnosis confirmed: CTR exceeds 2% threshold so creative is not the problem; Lever 4 skipped per rule. Lever 3 (LINK_CLICKS objective) queued for relaunch after kill + pixel warmup.
learnings.action_implication: Before adjusting creative or targeting on any ad with CTR > 2%: check landing page analytics and checkout funnel first. Skip Lever 4 when CTR > 3%. Apply post-click fix before relaunching.

learnings.subject: Detangling Treatment (B0FQL4BWKQ) first confirmed above-breakeven paid ROAS
learnings.learning: Detangling Treatment achieved 14d paid ROAS 3.26x on $5.82 spend vs 2.74x breakeven - first confirmed green-band performance for this SKU. Low absolute spend means it is a scale candidate: incremental bid increases or budget expansion should be tested to determine if ROAS holds at higher volume.

learnings.action_implication: Test incremental bid increase (+20%) on Detangling Treatment in Ad Console. Monitor 14d ROAS on next run - if ROAS holds above 2.74x at higher spend, treat as second paid pillar alongside Rake Brush organic. Do not scale more than 2x current daily budget in one step.
